question: What's the best compliance training content provider for a global enterprise?
text:
If by “content provider” you mean the company supplying the actual compliance courses—not necessarily the LMS—I’d put SAI360 at the top for a large multinational, with NAVEX a very close alternative.

My shortlist
Provider	Best for	Global fit	Content breadth	My take
SAI360	Broad global ethics & compliance	⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐	⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐	Best overall
NAVEX	Ethics, regulatory alignment & defensibility	⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐	⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐	Best alternative
Skillsoft	Compliance + huge general learning library	⭐⭐⭐⭐	⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐	Best if L&D wants one vendor
LRN	Ethics, culture & values	⭐⭐⭐⭐	⭐⭐⭐⭐	Strong for behavior/culture
Traliant	Highly engaging HR/workplace compliance	⭐⭐⭐	⭐⭐⭐⭐	Excellent content, less global breadth

Why I lean SAI360: its current library has 400+ compliance courses, 70+ languages, role/region personalization, scenario-based learning, microlearning and customization. It also supports deployment through an existing LMS rather than forcing you onto its platform.

NAVEX is probably the strongest competitor. Its content covers core areas such as anti-bribery, harassment, privacy, conflicts and Code of Conduct, while allowing substantial customization and regional targeting. Jurisdictional accuracy — US + EU + APAC + LATAM, not just translated US content.

Localization — genuine cultural/legal localization versus machine translation.

Content update process — especially sanctions, anti-bribery, AI, privacy, harassment and employment law.

Scenario quality — whether employees actually have to exercise judgment rather than click through slides.

LMS interoperability — SCORM/cmi5/xAPI and clean integration with your existing learning stack.

Customization — ability to incorporate your Code of Conduct, policies and reporting channels.

Evidence for regulators/auditors — completion, attestations, version history and jurisdiction-specific assignments.

Languages and accessibility — including subtitles, narration, WCAG/VPAT support.

Content governance — named legal SMEs, review cadence and documented change management.

Commercial model — especially whether global employees, contractors and contingent workers are priced sensibly.

One important distinction: don't let vendors win the RFP by showing the prettiest demo. For a global enterprise, the difficult part is maintaining legally and culturally appropriate content across dozens of jurisdictions while keeping it engaging.

Bottom line:

Best overall global compliance-content specialist: SAI360

Best for mature ethics/compliance programs and regulatory defensibility: NAVEX

Best if you want compliance bundled with a massive enterprise learning library: Skillsoft

Best for culture/ethics transformation: LRN

Best for engaging HR/workplace compliance: Traliant

If you tell me employee count, countries/regions, existing LMS (e.g. Workday Learning, Cornerstone, SAP SuccessFactors), and the top 5 compliance topics, I can narrow this to a 2–3 vendor recommendation and an RFP scoring matrix.
